Baal's Minion (Guest Monster)
Slayer (Animal), Hell Spawn (Demon), Greater Hell Spawn (Demon)

The newest monsters created by Baal to serve in his army of destruction, they are stealthy, quick-footed, and unusually tough for their size. Bony knobs protrude from their thick hides, giving them added protection against melee weapons.

Tips and Other Additional Information
There is also a different monster type, "Baal's Minions", that spawns in the Throne of Destruction. Baal has many minions.

Minions sometimes become Suicide Minions when provoked by Overseers. They can also become Frenzied.
